names.ja: Signal ネイビー＆ゴールド

intro.zh: 深藏蓝页面配骨白衬线标题和金色数字，间或换成纸色浅页；适合投资人材料、董事会汇报、咨询交付和政策简报。
intro.en: Bone serif headlines and gold numerals on deep navy, with occasional pale paper pages; for investor decks, board presentations, consulting deliverables and policy briefs.
intro.ja: 深いネイビーに骨白のセリフ見出しと金色の数字、ところどころ紙色のページを挟む。投資家向け資料、取締役会報告、コンサルティング成果物向け。

routing.avoid: Playful, fast or intentionally loud material.

recipe.composition: Deep navy pages with bone serif headlines set left under a hairline; every few content pages switch to a pale paper canvas. Gold is the only accent and is kept for numerals, small dashes and one chart series.
recipe.components: Bare gold serif numerals, open columns under a thin gold rule, numbered steps joined by arrows, slate-and-gold charts. No filled card grids, no second accent colour.
recipe.narrative: Title, section, thesis, evidence with image, three metrics, quotation, principles, current versus proposed, analysis, restated thesis, chart, process, breakdown, hierarchy, timeline, cycle, close.
recipe.nativeCoverage: Cover, chapter, statement, split text with image region, metric row, quotation, list, comparison, text columns, bar chart, numbered process, pie chart, pyramid, timeline, cycle and closing as native text, shapes, charts; Source Serif 4, the faint page grid, the donut legend list, the vertical timeline, the 2×2 cycle and the mixed event-list page are not reproduced.

pageMapping.differences: The faint grid over the navy canvas is not drawn.
Source sets the heading and a paragraph beside the image, vertically centred; native keeps the heading at the top, and the image region is filled only by a planned asset.
Source centres the heading and the metric row vertically; native starts them from the top.
Source sets a smaller regular-weight quotation under a gold quotation glyph, centred vertically; native uses the bold statement size under a gold dash.
Source places the heading in a left column beside the list with gold dash markers; native puts the heading above a bulleted list.
Source has no page heading and a vertical hairline between the columns; native adds a heading and draws a gold rule above each column.
Source combines a dated event list, a 2×2 metric grid and an analysis line on one page; the native sample shows only the metric row.
Source is two columns of running paragraphs under mono labels; native shows short rule-topped blocks, three across in the sample.
Native chart with editable data; source bars are slate with only the last bar in gold, native bars are one series colour.
Source is a donut ring beside a ruled percentage list; native is a pie chart with its own legend.
Source shades the levels from gold to slate; native fills only the top level in gold.
Source timeline runs down the page with year labels in the left margin; native timeline runs left to right.
Source arranges four numbered steps in a 2×2 grid with arrows around the loop; native shows one row of four boxes and a note that the last step feeds the first.
